==Usage==
This is an infobox for technical and usage information on any form of weapon. The fields are relevant to mass-produced weapons and unique weapons, but excluding lightsabers which use {{Tl|Lightsaber}}.

==Instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields (put the relevant information after the "=" signs). Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page. If no fields in a sub-section are used, placing a 1 (or any other text) in the <tt>hidex</tt> field will hide the sub-section.
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>{{Weapon

==Data fields==
*image &ndash; Put a link to the main image which represents the weapon. If the image is 250 pixels wide or larger, specify an image width of 250 pixels. If the image is smaller than 250 pixels wide, do not specify the size.
*name &ndash; Simply list the name of the weapon. Do not include any parenthetical disambiguation.
*manufacturer &ndash; Put the manufacturer name here (use <tt>creators</tt> if a specific person created it)
*model &ndash; List the full official weapon model name
*type &ndash; The type of weapon (e.g. "Vibroblade" or "Blaster rifle")
*culture &ndash; List the cultures that used the weapon or cultures in which it is otherwise prominent
*creators &ndash; List the creators of the weapon (in the case of specific individuals)
*created &ndash; The date the weapon was created
*destroyed &ndash; The date the weapon was destroyed
*discovered &ndash; The date the weapon was discovered, if previously lost or hidden
*owners &ndash; List owners of the weapon only if it is unique <small>&rarr; per [[Forum:CT:"Owners" field of the Weapon infobox|"Owners" field of the Weapon infobox]]</small>
*locations &ndash; List locations where the weapon was known to be used
*cost &ndash; List the cost of the weapon (and the currency type if known)
*value &ndash; List the real worth of the weapon
*shape &ndash; List features of the shape of the weapon
*size &ndash; Size of the weapon
*material &ndash; List materials from which the weapon is made
*length &ndash; Length of the weapon
*width &ndash; Width of the weapon
*diam &ndash; Diameter of the weapon
*height &ndash; Height of the weapon
*weight &ndash; Weight of the weapon
*protection &ndash; List the types of attacks that the weapon provided protection against
*crew &ndash; Number of crew required to operate the weapon
*capacity &ndash; The ammunition capacity of the weapon
*range &ndash; The range of the weapon or of the projectiles it fired
*inscription &ndash; List any inscriptions on the weapon
*markings &ndash; List any distinct markings on the weapon
*purpose &ndash; List any special purposes of the weapon
*heritage &ndash; The heritage of the weapon
*affiliation &ndash; List the governments and major organizations that used the weapon here
